A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: descendantOf

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

Commentary on an assertion that an annotator has made.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.

Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` typed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.
The location for dropping off or delivering a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.
Title of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Describes if any sensitive personal information is present in the dataset.
Prescribes the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Conducting controlled tests, experiments or simulations to verify that specific requirements regarding performance, functionality, robustness, etc. are met.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship is directionless).
The boundary parameters define the area or region needed to describe a boundary.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been evaluated on the `to` Element(s).
A value used in a generic key-value pair.
Uniquely identifies an external element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset can be shared within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isrc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)](https://isrc.ifpi.org/isrc-standard) is a unique 12-character alphanumeric identifier for sound recordings and music video recordings standardized by [ISO 3901](https://www.iso.org/standard/64817.html). While the "ISRC" label and grouping hyphens used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `USCA28900153`).
The headquartersLocation defines the location of the organization's headquarters.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
An actual change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).
Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.
Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.
The record of destruction is entered in this action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: any hashing algorithm that does not exist in this list of entries

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
Use Process defines actions used by elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256

Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Absolute URL that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 7230](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7230/) Section 2.7.1 or Section 2.7.2.
Defines the version of a specific process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact

A license expression participating in a license set.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.

Confidentiality level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application

Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.

Text specifying the postal code for an address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

A canonical, unique, immutable identifier of the artifact content, that may be used for verifying its identity and/or integrity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend

CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
A code that identifies a county.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
Location of a specific action.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. Categories of presence or absence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.
Describes the type of annotation.
Type of data in a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset may be distributed freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.
Records if sensitive personal information is used during model training or could be used during the inference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
processReadiness describes the readiness of a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
The percentile of the current probability score.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

Provides a map of a property name to a value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.

A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.

Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.

Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to verification items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html).
